verdicts.reason: Both break the same way. The wind turbine, which was the hero, is shrunk to a tiny icon squeezed into a bottom strip with clipped shards of the coloured triangles and broken line fragments. The diagonal lines float around the oversized headline with no structure. A's headline sits left of centre and out of line with the turbine below it, and its right-hand line runs almost into 'SUMMIT'. B's headline is better centred over the icon and has more clearance from the lines, so it is slightly less bad.
